coverTitle:
Five Prayers
For The Body
That's Still Healing
coverDek: For the diagnosis you're still waiting on, the pain that won't explain itself, and the body you're learning to trust again — five prayers for when your health feels like the one thing you can't control.

points.hook: Lord, I've read that pamphlet three times and I still don't understand what's happening to me.
paragraphs: The waiting room chairs are the same colour as the hallway, and the results haven't come back yet, and you've read every pamphlet twice hoping one sentence will make the fear smaller. Lord, I don't need to understand everything happening in my body tonight — I just need to know You're in the room with the results, before I am.
points.verseText: He sent his word, and healed them, and delivered them from their destructions.

points.hook: I decree over this body: every sickness assigned to steal my years will not stand.
paragraphs: I decree over this body, in the name of Jesus: every sickness assigned to cut short what God numbered for me will not stand! By the stripes of Jesus I am healed — not maybe, not someday, but by a finished work two thousand years settled. Sickness, hear the word of the Lord: you are trespassing on property that has already been bought back!
points.verseText: By whose stripes ye were healed.

points.hook: Notice what the fear is doing to your shoulders before the doctor even calls.
paragraphs: Notice where you're holding this in your body right now — the tight jaw, the shoulders creeping toward your ears, the breath you've been taking in halves instead of whole. Lord, my body has been carrying the appointment I haven't even had yet. Let Your peace reach the actual muscle, not just the thought, and loosen what fear has been gripping since the pain started.
points.verseText: Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.

points.hook: Somebody in this family has been carrying a diagnosis alone because they didn't want to be a burden.
paragraphs: Somebody in this family has been sitting with a diagnosis by themselves because they didn't want to trouble anyone else with it. Family, we were never meant to pray for our own bodies in isolation — is any sick among you? let him call for the elders, let the house pray. If that's you tonight, stop carrying this alone; let us stand in the gap until the strength comes back.
points.verseText: Is any sick among you? let him call for the elders of the church; and let them pray over him.

points.hook: Child, I see the pain you haven't told anyone the full truth about.
paragraphs: Child, I see the pain you've been downplaying so nobody worries, and I see the nights you lay there doing the math on what this might mean. I am the Lord that healeth thee — not a distant doctor reading your chart, but a Father who counts every hour of this. Rest in My hands tonight; I'm not finished with your body yet.
points.verseText: I am the LORD that healeth thee.

cta.closingLine: If your body is carrying something tonight, don't carry it in silence — come back tomorrow for the next series.
